description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractTransformer' in the Goteo project, which implements data transformation and normalization for models, including methods for retrieving model properties, generating URLs, and handling associated user and image data.

classes.name: AbstractTransformer
classes.description: An abstract class providing common data transformation functionalities for models within the Goteo project.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the transformer with a model and optional keys.

methods.name: rebuild
methods.description: Rebuilds the data array based on current keys and model data.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the associated model.

methods.name: getModelName
methods.description: Returns a URL-friendly name of the model.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Associates a User object with the transformer.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the associated User object.

methods.name: setKeys
methods.description: Sets the keys used for data rebuilding.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Retrieves the current set of keys.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Gets a label for a given key, used for display purposes.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a key from the data array.

methods.name: getRawValue
methods.description: Retrieves the raw value of a property from the model.

methods.name: getApiProperty
methods.description: Generates an API URL for modifying a property.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the model's ID.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the model's name or title.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Placeholder for generating a link; returns empty string.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns a link to the model's image.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns a link to the model's icon.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the model's title.

methods.name: getSubTitle
methods.description: Returns the model's subtitle.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns formatted date from the model.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns available actions for the model, e.g., edit URL.

methods.name: getLangs
methods.description: Returns available languages for the model.

methods.name: getActive
methods.description: Returns whether the model is active.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the model's order value.

methods.name: getCity
methods.description: Returns the city associated with the model.
